transitions.action: Keep preference; clear episode_served; command both pumps off.
Select a healthy pump using the current preference; set episode_served if a pump is selected.
Reselect immediately from current faults; retain episode_served once set.
Toggle preference if episode_served was TRUE; clear episode_served; command both pumps off.

priorities: A faulted pump must never be commanded on.
No demand commands both pumps off.
With demand, select the healthy preferred pump, otherwise the healthy standby; select neither if both are faulted.
On a served episode's falling edge, toggle preference once, regardless of which pump served it. Unserved episodes do not toggle.
Fault changes take effect in the current scan; no transfer delay or fault latch is specified.

initial_values.note: These are instance values before the first invocation. Inputs are externally supplied; scratch values are overwritten on each scan.

scan_execution_order.name: Edge sampling
actions: Sample Demand, FaultA and FaultB once into sampled_demand, sampled_fault_a and sampled_fault_b.
Compute falling_demand := previous_demand AND NOT sampled_demand using the retained pre-scan value.

scan_execution_order.name: Safety/reset priority and state transitions
actions: If falling_demand AND episode_served, set lead_pref := NOT lead_pref; otherwise retain lead_pref.
Compute candidate_a := sampled_demand AND NOT sampled_fault_a AND (lead_pref OR sampled_fault_b).
Compute candidate_b := sampled_demand AND NOT sampled_fault_b AND (NOT lead_pref OR sampled_fault_a).
If sampled_demand is FALSE, set episode_served := FALSE; otherwise set episode_served := episode_served OR candidate_a OR candidate_b.
Set previous_demand := sampled_demand. There is no external reset input; instance initialization supplies the reset values.

scan_execution_order.name: Unconditional top-level timer FB calls outside CASE/IF
actions: No timer FBs or timer calls are required.

scan_execution_order.name: Unified output assignments
actions: Assign PumpA := candidate_a, PumpB := candidate_b and LeadA := lead_pref exactly once.
Observe these post-transition outputs at the end of the same scan.
